transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because I’m just tired all the time. And it's not really the normal teacher-at-the-end-of-the-day tired, either. It's more like... even after a full night’s sleep, I just have to constantly push myself through everything. Just getting through grading my students' papers, making dinner, and getting ready for the next morning feels like a struggle.
Do you find that you still get enjoyment or pleasure out of the things you used to love, or has that changed recently?

It's definitely changed. I mean, most days I can still smile for my students and get through the lessons okay. But underneath that, it feels like... well, there’s just this gray, flat feeling. It kind of follows me home at the end of the day. So when I try to do the things I usually love, like working in my garden or doing my watercolors, they just seem really far away now. I don't really get the same feeling from them anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been... well, a while now. I'd say it's been going on for about two years and two months. It started right around the time my husband stopped working outside the home. Our whole household routine changed back then, and... yeah, I've pretty much felt this way ever since.
During these past two years, have there been any periods of at least two months where you felt completely like your normal self, free of these symptoms?
No, not really. I don't think there's been any stretch of time like that. It's just been a constant thing for the whole two years.

Have you ever experienced a period of two weeks or longer where you felt significantly worse than you do now, perhaps feeling completely hopeless, worthless, or having thoughts that life wasn't worth living?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really had a time where it got severely worse like that, or where I felt completely hopeless or anything. It's just been this same, steady, flat feeling the whole time.
